name: Adapted Cuckoo Hashing for Voxel Labels
aliases: Cuckoo hashing variant for voxel label caching
definition: A hash table method for caching voxel labels (λ) and keys (k) in 4D space (voxel v, LOD l). It uses two hash functions to determine positions, allowing elements to be stored in either a first or second position. This supports constant-time lookups and handles collisions via ejection, but is adapted to handle cases where an element cannot be moved back to its first position.
summary: Adapted Cuckoo Hashing for Voxel Labels is a sparse caching method for volume rendering that limits ejection recursion to one step to reduce GPU thread divergence, unlike standard Cuckoo hashing.
